# VoilitAI

> VoilitAI is an AI agent platform that lets businesses create AI employees to answer calls, qualify leads, and book appointments. Voice is live today; chat, SMS, and more share the same agent next.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://voilitai.com/): AI agent platform for businesses
- [AI voice agents](https://voilitai.com/ai-voice-agents/): Product overview for voice agents
- [AI voice employees](https://voilitai.com/ai-voice-employees/): Create your own AI employee
- [AI receptionist](https://voilitai.com/ai-receptionist/): Front-desk call answering
- [AI phone agent](https://voilitai.com/ai-phone-agent/): Phone agent for inbound and outbound
- [Features](https://voilitai.com/features/): Platform capabilities
- [Pricing](https://voilitai.com/pricing/): Plans and usage
- [How it works](https://voilitai.com/how-it-works/): Create, connect, deploy
- [Product app](https://app.voilitai.com/): Create your AI employee

## Built-in connectors

Connect from Integrations in the product:

- Google Calendar (OAuth) — calendar.book
- HubSpot (OAuth) — hubspot.contact
- Slack (OAuth) — slack.notify
- Email · Resend (API key) — email.send
- SMS · Twilio (credentials) — sms.send
- WhatsApp · Twilio (credentials)
- Outbound calls (platform calling) — voice.call
- Custom APIs — connect another system (EHR, CRM, or any REST API)
